title: Inspect the constants
explanation: ReviewPriority declares three named instances. Input parsing chooses one of them; it does not create a fourth priority.

title: Normalize one input
explanation: Our parse method trims spaces and uses Locale.ROOT before calling valueOf. The result is the existing HIGH constant with its declared weight.

title: Reject an unknown name
explanation: URGENT is not declared. parse throws IllegalArgumentException; no extra enum value is invented and no default priority is silently chosen.
